scripts.bundle_downloads_schema: pnpm --package=@redocly/cli dlx redocly bundle galaxy.downloads.openapi.json --ext json  -o galaxy_downloads.bundle.openapi.json
scripts.create_json_schema: cat <(pnpm dlx node-jq 'del(.definitions, .type, .items)' galaxy.schema.json) <(pnpm dlx node-jq '.paths["/{filename}"].get.responses["200"].content["application/json"].schema,{definitions:.components.schemas}' galaxy_downloads.bundle.openapi.json) |pnpm dlx node-jq -s add >galaxy.new.schema.json
scripts.downgrade_merged_openapi: bash -c "pnpm --package=@apiture/openapi-down-convert dlx openapi-down-convert --input <(pnpm --package=@redocly/cli dlx redocly bundle  --ext json merged.downloads.openapi.json) --output merged.downloads.old.openapi.json"
scripts.downgrade_api_openapi: bash -c "pnpm --package=@apiture/openapi-down-convert dlx openapi-down-convert --input <(pnpm --package=@redocly/cli dlx redocly bundle --ext json  api.openapi.json) --output api.old.openapi.json"
scripts.convert_merged_openapi_to_json_schema: bash -c "pnpm --package=@openapi-contrib/openapi-schema-to-json-schema dlx openapi-schema-to-json-schema --input <(cat <(pnpm dlx node-jq 'del(.definitions, .type, .items)' galaxy.schema.json) <(pnpm --package=@redocly/cli dlx redocly bundle  --ext json merged.downloads.openapi.json|pnpm dlx node-jq '.paths[\"/{filename}\"].get.responses[\"200\"].content[\"application/json\"].schema,{definitions:.components.schemas}') |pnpm dlx node-jq -s add|sed -e 's/#/components/schemas//#/definitions//')/ --output merged.old.schema.json"
scripts.convert_galaxy_openapi_to_json_schema: bash -c "pnpm --package=@openapi-contrib/openapi-schema-to-json-schema dlx openapi-schema-to-json-schema --input <(cat <(pnpm dlx node-jq 'del(.definitions, .type, .items)' galaxy.schema.json) <(pnpm --package=@redocly/cli dlx redocly bundle  --ext json galaxy.downloads.openapi.json|pnpm dlx node-jq '.paths[\"/{filename}\"].get.responses[\"200\"].content[\"application/json\"].schema,{definitions:.components.schemas}') |pnpm dlx node-jq -s add|sed -e 's/#\/components\/schemas\//#\/definitions\//') --output galaxy.old.schema.json"
